en: The postcard features a black and white photograph of a tree-lined avenue with tall, well-manicured trees on both sides, forming a natural corridor along the wide path. The setting feels historical and serene. At the bottom of the front, handwritten-style text reads 'Bad Pyrmont' and 'Bomberg-Allee.' The back contains a printed message in German referencing the location as 'Heerbad Pyrmont' and the phrase 'Schönster Kurpark Deutschlands!,' alongside a stamp for 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont.'
